Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the beta handoff checklist and feedback SLAs for the next design partner cohort. Proposal below, please react with duties you can take and any missing items.

Maya (PM): Proposed handoff outline:
1) 2-week active beta window per partner
2) Onboarding runbook + access checklist (secrets, VPC, logs)
3) Acceptance criteria (perf + quality)
4) Feedback loop cadence + survey template
5) Escalation & rollback plan
6) Telemetry & export for partners

Sam (Eng): I can own the rollout automation (feature flags + canary). Need the exact acceptance metrics for the canary, otherwise I'll default to perf-only gating.

Arjun (DevEx): I'll draft the onboarding runbook and a short CLI-based setup flow. Recommend a one-click token generator + example curl snippets. Also want a standard partner-facing README.

Leah (CS): Partners asked for clear SLAs around data retention and an explicit contact for incidents. They also want hourly activity logs for the first 48h after onboarding. We'll need a comms template.

Kevin (Research): For quality gating we need an eval harness — I'll assemble a 20-prompt seed set and a small automatic regression check (BLEU/ROUGE is weak; suggest embedding delta + manual spot checks).

Sam (Eng): For metrics, propose:
- Latency: p50 and p95 within 2x of baseline (baseline = prod stable model on same config)
- Error budget: <1% downstream failures
- Quality: no more than 3 failing prompts from the seeded eval set (manual review threshold)
If a canary trips, auto-rollback to previous model/version.

Maya (PM): Sounds reasonable. Add requirement: no privacy/data leaks in sample responses (CS to verify). Also rollout should include a small blacklist of unsafe prompts to monitor.

Leah (CS): Noted. I'll add data-retention language and escalation contact. Also will prepare a short customer-facing SLA doc with bullet points.

Kevin (Research): I'll build an eval script. Example command I plan to run locally:
```
./eval_harness --base v1.3.0 --candidate v1.4.0 --prompts seeds.json --embedding-threshold 0.08
```
We can surface the report in the onboarding portal.

Arjun (DevEx): For feedback loops, propose:
- Weekly async report for the first month
- Dedicated biweekly 30m sync during active beta
- Survey at week 1 and week 2 (short, 6 questions)
I'll attach the survey template to the runbook.

Sam (Eng): Ops integration notes:
- We'll enable prefix/KV caching by default for partners on Dedicated mode
- Telemetry: expose per-route token counts, latency histograms, and a sample output stream (redacted)
- Command for automated regression diff: `./compare-outputs --base v1 --cand v2 --threshold 0.03`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary: 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC (canary window: 60m)

Maya (PM): Action items (assignments):
- Sam: rollout automation + canary gating (owner)
- Arjun: onboarding runbook + portal templates (owner)
- Kevin: eval harness + seed prompts (owner)
- Leah: partner SLAs + comms templates (owner)
- Maya: overall program coordination + success metrics definition (owner)

Maya (PM): Success criteria draft:
- 80% of partners complete active window without critical incidents
- Mean latency within target and error budget respected
- Feedback response rate >= 60% for in-window surveys
- No P0/P1 security incidents

Leah (CS): I'll coordinate partner emails and ask for feedback on the proposed cadence. Will also flag any legal/KYC requirements early.

Sam (Eng): One open question — rollback SLO: immediate rollback on canary fail or wait for triage? My preference: immediate auto-rollback plus async triage.

Maya (PM): Agree with immediate rollback. We keep the triage window after rollback to avoid user impact. Document rollback steps in runbook.

Kevin (Research): Proposed timeline: share runbook + eval harness by Tue EOD, onboarding portal prototype Wed, first cohort onboarded by Apr 12. Is that too aggressive?

Arjun (DevEx): That's tight but doable if we keep scope narrow for v0. Minimal portal + runbook first.

Leah (CS): I'll prepare partner comms draft by Tue as well.

Maya (PM): Okay — final ask: everyone react with :thumbsup: if you're good with assignments and timeline, or reply with blockers. We'll lock the plan in tomorrow's PM sync.

Sam (Eng): :thumbsup:
Arjun (DevEx): :thumbsup:
Leah (CS): :thumbsup:
Kevin (Research): :thumbsup:
Maya (PM): Thanks — will update the doc and add links to the onboarding repo shortly.
